subject: Quick note about Manhattan Plumbing's website

headers.subject: Quick note about Manhattan Plumbing's website

text:
Hi Manhattan Plumbing team,

I'm Alex Rivera, a web designer in New York. I was looking at your website and noticed Copyright 2016 — and since most customers now browse on their phones, that's likely costing you calls.

A modern rebuild usually pays for itself fast: quicker load, mobile-friendly layout, and a clear click-to-call button.

Want me to send over a quick mockup of what a refresh for Manhattan Plumbing could look like? Reply and I'll put one together — free, no strings.

Best,
Alex Rivera
